title: Reading the weather: Beaufort, forecasts, meltemi
h1: Reading the weather: Beaufort, forecasts, meltemi
lead: Good skippers decide most of their day before they leave the berth. Here is how to read the Beaufort scale and a forecast, know the Mediterranean's local winds, and make a calm go or no-go call.
description: Learn the Beaufort scale, where to get Mediterranean sailing forecasts, how to read gusts, and how the meltemi, sirocco and bora affect a 40 ft yacht.
summary: Forecast wind is the mean; plan and reef for the gusts.
Use several sources: national services, NAVTEX, VHF and grib apps.
The meltemi builds through the day, so sail early.
If in doubt, wait in harbour.
